items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: My name is [sounds like] Johnny Enoch.

ctx.x: Now by the way, you may have noticed you don’t hear yourself in the mic. Just go right ahead.
My name is [sounds like] Johnny Enoch. My question is —
Enoch? I have a song called “Enoch’s Meditation.”
